plugins.name: pathtrove
plugins.description: Look up computational-pathology datasets in PathTrove, in Chinese or English: table search and statistics, resource reports (value, text, source), download plans, label summaries. The data package (~14 MB) is downloaded from the public Hugging Face repo Dearcat/PathTrove on first use and cached locally (no key, no server); raw label files are downloaded one at a time.
